reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread. I told her I can't confirm the 17 November Halyard deadline for Marrow Agrisupply, and that I'm treating it as unverified hearsay, not a real date.

I searched the knowledge brain and only looked at what Dana herself can see: the channels she's in and the public files. The only place the Halyard rollout or a 17 November date came up was her own message.

Marrow Agrisupply is a Central team account, so I suggested she check the date with them. I didn't read the Central channels, because Dana isn't a member of them.
